services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Parties of 20+ are scheduled on a case-by-case basis, generally held on the weekdays in the early afternoon due to capacity and parking constraints. Generally speaking, we cannot accommodate groups larger than 20 people during peak hours. The latest reservation start time every night is 6 pm. Reservations must be planned out with the event coordinator at least a week in advance. Our first come first serve policy applies to individuals, not large parties. We reserve the right to refuse service to parties that have not been scheduled and approved by our Event Coordinator.
